en: Jasmine
Thank you again for Amphy. Now let me show you the other side of me: a Gym Leader's.
My Pokémon are of steel. They're harder than anything you've faced. Are you ready?
Your Pokémon cut through steel... You're stronger than I imagined. The Mineral Badge is yours.
{player} received the Mineral Badge from Jasmine!
Wear it proudly. Steel only grows harder under the hammer, and so do the Trainers who keep going.
And please take this. A move I'm very fond of.
TM23 is Iron Tail. It strikes with a tail as hard as steel, and may lower the foe's Defense.
Amphy shines every night now. Whenever I see its light out at sea, I think of you.
Gym Guide
Hey there, challenger! Sorry, the Leader's out. Jasmine's up at the lighthouse, looking after a sick Pokémon.
She won't battle anyone until it's well again. That's just how kind she is.
Jasmine's back! And she's not the gentle girl you'd think in battle. Her Steel types barely feel a scratch.
Fire, Fighting and Ground moves are your best bet. Good luck, champ!
You broke through her steel! I knew there was something about you.
Gentleman
Jasmine is back, and so are we. She battles beautifully. I wouldn't miss it for the world.
What a battle! Jasmine looked happy, even in defeat. You must have reminded her of something.
Girl
I heard Jasmine was too worried to battle while that Ampharos was sick. She's so kind!
You beat Jasmine? Wow... I want to be strong and kind, just like her.
